entry.title: Minister Miller announces appointment of Graham Carr as the next Chairperson of the Board of Trustees of the Canadian Museum of History
entry.summary: Graham Carr has been appointed Chairperson of the Board of Trustees of the Canadian Museum of History for a term of four years, effective September 26,2026

entry.title: Government of Canada invests in new small craft harbour in Arctic Bay, Nunavut, enhancing marine access and local opportunities
entry.summary: Small craft harbours are vitally important to coastal communities and to Canada’s fishing economies. In the Arctic, these harbours serve as critical community marine infrastructure that enhance safety, improve access and contribute to Canada’s broader Arctic sovereignty.

entry.title: Minister Sidhu strengthens partnerships and advances Canada’s trade priorities at G20 Trade Ministers’ Meeting
entry.summary: Yesterday, the Honourable Maninder Sidhu, Minister of International Trade, concluded his participation in the G20 Trade Ministers’ Meeting in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, advancing Canada’s trade priorities and strengthening its relationships with trusted and reliable partners.

entry.title: Seizures of contraband and unauthorized items at Collins Bay Institution
entry.summary: Between September 25 and September 30, 2026, as a result of the vigilance of staff members, multiple packages containing contraband and unauthorized items were seized at Collins Bay Institution, a multi-level security federal institution.

entry.title: Minister Sidhu and India's Minister of Commerce and Industry meet to advance Canada-India trade and investment priorities
entry.summary: This week, the Honourable Maninder Sidhu, Minister of International Trade, met with Piyush Goyal, India’s Minister of Commerce and Industry, on the margins of the G20 Trade Ministers’ Meeting in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.
